title: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back
summary: In a pilot project in a village in southern Lebanon, Israeli forces have left and the Lebanese army moved it. But villagers who return find their houses wrecked.
contentText:
In a pilot project in a village in southern Lebanon, Israeli forces have left and the Lebanese army moved it. But villagers who return find their houses wrecked.
